capabilities: Schedule spaced-repetition reviews of notes with 1-5 scores written to frontmatter
Group notes into tests and track exam preparation dates
Generate flashcard decks and quizzes from notes with AI
Chat with an AI planner about what reviews and tests are due
Index the vault locally for AI-powered semantic search
extras: Originally named Cortex and renamed to avoid clashing with an existing plugin. AI features are optional and can be disabled entirely; review tracking works fully offline. API keys are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition or study-planning tools, so learners must track reviews by hand or use separate flashcard apps.
